restatement: Add a core analyze(template) function that walks the parsed AST (and the evaluator's own expression splitting) to report every input variable a template reads: its root name, the distinct full paths, the constructs that read it (output, if, elseif, case, for source, list_item, table cells, condition operands on both sides of AND/OR/comparisons/contains), and whether every read has a ?? default (optional). It also lists the filters applied with counts and flags unknown filters as diagnostics. FOR item names inside their loop, @-metadata and operator words are not inputs. The n8n node's strict-mode pre-check switches to analyze, so it no longer rejects loop item names or ??-defaulted variables, and the regex-based extractAllVariables is removed from core. No existing test body may change and no runtime dependency may be added.
verification_plan: c1: confirm analyze visits Variable, If (with ELSEIF as nested alternate), Case, For iterable, ListItem condition and table Header/Row cells, tagging each with the right usedIn kind, and that table cells win over output inside a table

c2: confirm condition operands are split on AND/OR/&&/||, comparison operators and string operators (contains right side included), and that literals (numbers, quoted strings, true/false/null) are skipped
c3: confirm FOR item names are scoped to the loop body only (still reported when used outside), @-prefixed names are dropped, and NOT / ! / NOT(...) are stripped, never recorded
c4: confirm optional is true only when every read carries a ?? default, and that the node's strict check exempts optional variables while resolveTemplate still renders the default
c5: confirm every filter name is counted from the parsed filter list and that names outside the implemented set (head, tail, trim, escape_md) produce a diagnostic naming the filter
c6: confirm the node computes missing names from analyze output, so a loop item name never counts as unmapped, while an unmapped loop source still errors with 'unmapped variables: xs'
c7: confirm utils.ts is deleted, index.ts no longer re-exports it, and no file under core/src mentions extractAllVariables
rubric: confirm no regex runs over the raw template source to find variables (regexes on already-isolated condition or path text are acceptable)
m1: confirm no test file is modified or deleted in the diff
m2: confirm no package.json dependency is added and analyze imports only sibling core modules

goal-critical Qs: check that red evidence exists showing the frozen tests failed for the stated reasons before, that tests/analyze.test.ts passes after, and that any remaining suite failures are unrelated to this change
scope: confirm edits stay within the files_scope plus the logged expressions.ts exception, and that the expressions.ts refactor preserves evaluator behaviour
